items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: So I was talking to Paul about it and he said, "Man, you're going to New York, man -- that's where you need to be." And he hung out with me all that night, and we partied

ctx.x: gonna -- none of us were gonna use any drugs at all, and blah, blah, blah. Sure.

Anyway, I get to New York and Paul told me in the train station, 'Look, man -- we got a place out in East New York' - they had a little inn out there or something like that -- and he said, 'you can stay out there until you get on your feet', you know; And, because I was trying to find all kinds of excuses not to leave Chicago.

And he said, 'No, man, you need to be in New York.' (Unintelligible). Anyway, I get on the plane to New York, and they had a one nighter down in Washington, D.C. They made it. They had Kenny Drew, Donald Bird, Ira Arnie Sullivan, and I forgot -- he used some bass player down in Washington in my place, but they came back the next morning, and our next engagement would be Washington for a week, and that's where I made it, and still, instead of my buying a suit, he said, 'Well, look, I got a suit', you know; I…
